messages:
mike_support: Heads-up — Acme AI opened an escalation. They saw a sudden drop in throughput last night and a bunch of 429s. They pasted headers showing x-burst-credits went to 0.
acme_admin: hey team — timeline: we had a marketing blast 2025-11-12T01:03:00Z, traffic spiked ~10x for ~45s then tapered. After ~30s into the spike we started getting 429s and higher latency. Sample response headers below.
acme_admin: ```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: 3f2a7c
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-burst-credits: 0
retry-after: 12
content-type: application/json
```
acme_admin: curl we used to hit the endpoint (redacted token):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"hello"}' 
  -D - | head -n 20
```
lena_support: thanks — can you share the account id and the app id that did the burst? also roughly what qps you saw at peak?
acme_admin: account: acct_9X7a, app: recommender-prod, peak ~120 req/s for ~45s. normal baseline ~12 req/s.
mike_support: copying in @kai_eng and @sophia_billing. sounds like they exhausted burst credits, not the monthly quota. confirm?
kai_eng: looking. if x-burst-credits is 0 that means short-term bucket drained. For Dedicated customers burst credits are proportional to reserved capacity; for Hosted they get a small refill pool. We need request traces and the client id to calculate exact consumption.
prod-eng: pinged infra to pull the token-level traces and the rate-limiter counters. linking monitoring graph: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/tx123/ratelimit?orgId=1&from=1699783380000&to=1699783500000 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ops-bot: deploy/ratelimiter v2.4.1 rolled at 2025-11-01T04:12:00Z. No config changes around incident window.
lena_support: acme — two quick asks: 1) can you run a short repro (we want to reproduce locally) and 2) paste any SDK retry/backoff config you use?
acme_admin: can repro with this hey command from a GCE instance:
```bash
hey -n 1000 -c 50 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -m POST -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
acme_admin: SDK retries are default JS client: retries=2, backoff=exponential starting at 200ms.
kai_eng: good repro. two explanations: 1) the leaky-bucket refills burst credits slowly; sustained 10x for 45s drains it. 2) client retries can amplify load during tail of spike if backoff is too short.
sophia_billing: account acct_9X7a has monthly token commit 500M, used 488M currently. They are not over monthly quota. Burst credits are separate and capped; we can do a one-time manual refill of 20k burst tokens while we investigate, if ops approves.
prod-eng: manual refill possible — propose temporary refill + soft rollback to avoid more 429s. but longer-term we should recommend smoothing on client side and/or bumping reserved capacity for recommender-prod.
kai_eng: suggestions to customer: 
- add jittered exponential backoff: base=500ms, max=5s, jitter=full
- reduce concurrent clients from 50 to 20 for the brief window when spike arrives
- implement client-side smoothing: ramp up QPS instead of instant 10x (example token-leaky config below)

Example smoothing config (internal names):
```
burst_smoothing_enabled: true
burst_smoothing_window_ms: 60000
burst_fill_rate_per_sec: 1000   # tokens/sec refill rate for app bucket
max_concurrency_override: 20
```

kai_eng: also, if they're on Dedicated we can increase reserved capacity (monthly commit) to change both steady throughput and burst pool size. For Hosted customers we can recommend request shaping and our recommended SDK config.
mike_support: acme — would you like the temporary refill while you roll the SDK change?
acme_admin: yes please, a short refill for the next 2 hours would prevent user-facing errors while we patch. thanks.
sophia_billing: will raise refill ticket and bill accordingly — marking as approved for 2h refill of 20k burst tokens.
prod-eng: ops — I'll schedule the refill now and watch metrics. also will add a dashboard alert for burst-credits <= 5% to prevent surprise 429s.
ops-bot: ticket #INC-9242 created for manual refill; ETA 10m.
kai_eng: final notes for postmortem: collect client-side QPS, server-side token consumption, and any retry storms. action items:
- prod-eng: monitor & rollback refill if abnormal (assigned)
- lena_support: send repro steps + suggested SDK snippet to customer (assigned)
- kai_eng: prepare short doc on recommended smoothing defaults for Hosted customers (assigned)
- sophia_billing: confirm billing and close ticket after 2h window (assigned)
mike_support: thanks all — keeping thread open until refill window ends and no more 429s. :thumbsup:
